verdict.rationale: The CLI is documented as runnable from 'anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron' and supports a stable `--json` output for scripting (foreloop-docs-16, foreloop-docs-9/18), suggesting some headless/CI usability. However, the core agent workflow is described as requiring a human to run the agent 'on your own machine' and approve every contract before work starts (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-7, foreloop-docs-20/22), which conflicts with a fully unattended CI/CD pipeline use case. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline example or docs, evidence of non-interactive/auto-approval mode, and confirmation the agent can run without a human approval step in an automated pipeline.
